# Introduction

The **`kappaSizeFixedN`** analysis (Lowest Expected Value for a fixed sample size) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- For an interobserver agreement study whose number of subjects is already fixed, the lowest kappa the study would still be unable to rule out - the lower bound of the one-sided confidence interval around the anticipated kappa (kappa0); every value below it is excluded. Computed with the kappaSize package. Use kappaSizePower to size a study for a hypothesis test and kappaSizeCI to size it for a target interval width.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("kappaSizeFixedN_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::kappaSizeFixedN(
#   data = kappaSizeFixedN_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `kappaSizeFixedN` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
